quests.instruction: Choose the best way to handle this situation.
quests.scene: A failing state threatens regional security and a humanitarian catastrophe.
quests.correctAnswer: Engage a multilateral stabilisation framework
quests.hint: No single nation should lead alone. A multilateral framework provides legitimacy and resource.
quests.explanation: Multilateral legitimacy is essential for stabilisation interventions.

quests.instruction: Choose the best way to handle this situation.
quests.scene: A failing state threatens regional security and a humanitarian catastrophe.
quests.correctAnswer: Prioritise civilian protection and humanitarian access above political outcomes
quests.hint: In state collapse situations protecting civilians and opening humanitarian corridors must precede political engineering.
quests.explanation: Prioritising humanitarian protection builds the trust that political solutions require.

quests.instruction: Choose the best way to handle this situation.
quests.scene: A failing state threatens regional security and a humanitarian catastrophe.
quests.correctAnswer: Support indigenous-led governance structures rather than imposing external models
quests.hint: Build on existing local governance capacity — clan structures local councils civic organisations — rather than imposing external models.
quests.explanation: Indigenous-led governance structures have legitimacy and capacity that externally imposed models consistently lack.

quests.instruction: Choose the best way to handle this situation.
quests.scene: A global cyber attack has disabled critical infrastructure in multiple countries simultaneously.
quests.correctAnswer: Activate international cyber incident response protocols immediately
quests.hint: NATO Article 5 and bilateral cyber defence agreements must be activated — this is a collective security event.
quests.explanation: Framing a massive cyber attack as a collective security event triggers treaty obligations and resources.

quests.instruction: Choose the best way to handle this situation.
quests.scene: A global cyber attack has disabled critical infrastructure in multiple countries simultaneously.
quests.correctAnswer: Attribute carefully before publicly naming a state actor
quests.hint: Attribution of state-sponsored cyber attacks requires rigorous technical and intelligence standards before public naming.
quests.explanation: Premature or inaccurate attribution of cyber attacks damages credibility and can escalate situations incorrectly.

quests.instruction: Choose the best way to handle this situation.
quests.scene: A global cyber attack has disabled critical infrastructure in multiple countries simultaneously.
quests.correctAnswer: Use the crisis to advance binding international cyber norms
quests.hint: Propose: 'This attack demonstrates the need for binding international law on attacks against civilian infrastructure.'
quests.explanation: Major cyber incidents create the political momentum that peacetime advocacy cannot generate for international cyber law.

quests.instruction: Choose the best way to handle this situation.
quests.scene: Ocean acidification is creating conflict between fishing nations and conservationists.
quests.correctAnswer: Establish internationally binding marine protected area agreements
quests.hint: Marine protected areas must be large enough legally binding and enforced — not aspirational designations.
quests.explanation: Binding enforced marine protections are the only mechanisms that change actual fishing behaviour at sea.

quests.instruction: Choose the best way to handle this situation.
quests.scene: Ocean acidification is creating conflict between fishing nations and conservationists.
quests.correctAnswer: Provide economic transition support for dependent fishing communities
quests.hint: Fishing communities dependent on affected species must receive economic alternatives — conservation without support breeds conflict.
quests.explanation: Economic alternatives for fishing communities reduce resistance to marine conservation measures.

quests.instruction: Choose the best way to handle this situation.
quests.scene: Ocean acidification is creating conflict between fishing nations and conservationists.
quests.correctAnswer: Include ocean carbon sequestration in climate frameworks
quests.hint: Protecting ocean health must be formally embedded in climate mitigation frameworks not treated as a separate agenda.
quests.explanation: Integration of ocean health into climate frameworks creates coherent policy that addresses interconnected causes.

quests.instruction: Choose the best way to handle this situation.
quests.scene: Quantum computing advances are making current encryption obsolete threatening global financial systems.
quests.correctAnswer: Mandate post-quantum cryptography transition timelines for critical infrastructure
quests.hint: Governments must require all critical infrastructure operators to complete post-quantum encryption transitions by specific dates.
quests.explanation: Mandated timelines are the only mechanism that creates the urgency this transition requires.

quests.instruction: Choose the best way to handle this situation.
quests.scene: Quantum computing advances are making current encryption obsolete threatening global financial systems.
quests.correctAnswer: Establish international information sharing on quantum cryptographic standards
quests.hint: Standards bodies must co-ordinate internationally: quantum-era cryptographic standards must be globally interoperable.
quests.explanation: International cryptographic standards prevent the fragmentation that creates exploitable gaps in global systems.

quests.instruction: Choose the best way to handle this situation.
quests.scene: Quantum computing advances are making current encryption obsolete threatening global financial systems.
quests.correctAnswer: Audit and prioritise the most critical data needing immediate protection
quests.hint: Begin with the most sensitive long-lived data: harvest-now decrypt-later attacks on today's data are already possible.
quests.explanation: Data sensitivity triage enables organisations to prioritise post-quantum migration where the risk is most acute.

quests.instruction: Choose the best way to handle this situation.
quests.scene: A major power is using economic coercion against a smaller allied nation.
quests.correctAnswer: Respond with collective economic countermeasures through allied institutions
quests.hint: Allies must respond collectively — unilateral responses by small nations are easily absorbed and invite further coercion.
quests.explanation: Collective economic responses impose costs on coercive powers that no individual nation can replicate alone.

quests.instruction: Choose the best way to handle this situation.
quests.scene: A major power is using economic coercion against a smaller allied nation.
quests.correctAnswer: Help the targeted nation rapidly diversify its economic relationships
quests.hint: Provide accelerated trade and investment access: 'We will offset the economic pressure through new relationships.'
quests.explanation: Economic diversification support is the most effective long-term structural response to economic coercion.

quests.instruction: Choose the best way to handle this situation.
quests.scene: A major power is using economic coercion against a smaller allied nation.
quests.correctAnswer: Establish anti-coercion norms in international trade law
quests.hint: Codify economic coercion as a violation of international trade law and create enforcement mechanisms.
quests.explanation: Codified anti-coercion norms create deterrence at scale for all nations exposed to economic intimidation.

quests.instruction: Choose the best way to handle this situation.
quests.scene: Global inequality is fuelling political instability and conflict in multiple regions simultaneously.
quests.correctAnswer: Reform international financial institutions to better serve developing economies
quests.hint: IMF and World Bank governance must reflect the current economic weight of developing nations.
quests.explanation: Institutional governance reform is the prerequisite for legitimacy in global financial institutions.

quests.instruction: Choose the best way to handle this situation.
quests.scene: Global inequality is fuelling political instability and conflict in multiple regions simultaneously.
quests.correctAnswer: Address illicit financial flows that drain developing economies
quests.hint: Developed nations must close tax havens and stop accepting illicit funds: inequality is partly structurally exported.
quests.explanation: Closing illicit financial flow mechanisms in wealthy nations directly reduces resource extraction from developing ones.

quests.instruction: Choose the best way to handle this situation.
quests.scene: Global inequality is fuelling political instability and conflict in multiple regions simultaneously.
quests.correctAnswer: Link trade agreements to enforceable labour and environmental standards
quests.hint: Trade agreements without enforceable standards create a race to the bottom that concentrates gains in wealthy nations.
quests.explanation: Enforceable standards in trade agreements prevent inequality from being structurally reproduced in global supply chains.

quests.instruction: Choose the best way to handle this situation.
quests.scene: Space resource competition is creating conflict between spacefaring nations.
quests.correctAnswer: Establish an international space resource governance body
quests.hint: An international body analogous to the International Seabed Authority is needed for space resource oversight.
quests.explanation: International governance bodies provide the legal framework that prevents unilateral appropriation of shared resources.

quests.instruction: Choose the best way to handle this situation.
quests.scene: Space resource competition is creating conflict between spacefaring nations.
quests.correctAnswer: Define space resource rights in international law before conflict emerges
quests.hint: The Outer Space Treaty's prohibition on national appropriation does not cover commercial extraction — this gap must be closed.
quests.explanation: Closing legal gaps before conflicts emerge is far cheaper than resolving disputes after.

quests.instruction: Choose the best way to handle this situation.
quests.scene: Space resource competition is creating conflict between spacefaring nations.
quests.correctAnswer: Create benefit-sharing mechanisms for space resources
quests.hint: A portion of space resource revenues should benefit non-spacefaring nations.
quests.explanation: Benefit-sharing mechanisms give all nations a stake in orderly space resource governance.

quests.instruction: Choose the best way to handle this situation.
quests.scene: Synthetic biology breakthroughs are creating biosecurity risks and international conflict.
quests.correctAnswer: Strengthen the Biological Weapons Convention with verification mechanisms
quests.hint: The BWC has no verification mechanism — this must be added as synthetic biology makes bioweapon creation more accessible.
quests.explanation: Verification mechanisms in arms control treaties are the difference between aspirational norms and effective deterrence.

quests.instruction: Choose the best way to handle this situation.
quests.scene: Synthetic biology breakthroughs are creating biosecurity risks and international conflict.
quests.correctAnswer: Implement international dual-use research oversight
quests.hint: Dual-use biological research must be reviewed by an international body before publication or commercialisation.
quests.explanation: Dual-use research oversight at the international level prevents the fastest-growing biosecurity risk from proliferating uncontrolled.

quests.instruction: Choose the best way to handle this situation.
quests.scene: Synthetic biology breakthroughs are creating biosecurity risks and international conflict.
quests.correctAnswer: Invest in global pandemic early warning and attribution capacity
quests.hint: Outbreak detection systems that can identify novel engineered pathogens are an essential global security infrastructure.
quests.explanation: Early detection and attribution capacity is the most direct investment in both biosecurity and biosafety simultaneously.

quests.instruction: Choose the best way to handle this situation.
quests.scene: A major civilisational values clash is preventing cooperation on existential risks.
quests.correctAnswer: Identify minimal overlapping consensus on shared survival interests
quests.hint: Even deeply different civilisations share an interest in avoiding nuclear war pandemic and ecological collapse. Start there.
quests.explanation: Minimal overlapping consensus on survival provides the foundation for co-operation despite civilisational difference.

quests.instruction: Choose the best way to handle this situation.
quests.scene: A major civilisational values clash is preventing cooperation on existential risks.
quests.correctAnswer: Design co-operation mechanisms that do not require shared values
quests.hint: Mutual interest not shared values is sufficient for co-operation on existential risks. Design accordingly.
quests.explanation: Interest-based rather than values-based co-operation frameworks are more durable across civilisational difference.

quests.instruction: Choose the best way to handle this situation.
quests.scene: A major civilisational values clash is preventing cooperation on existential risks.
quests.correctAnswer: Create scientific and technical working relationships that bypass political conflict
quests.hint: Direct scientist-to-scientist and technical expert exchange can build co-operation that political actors cannot.
quests.explanation: Technical co-operation pathways built outside political conflict create working relationships that outlast diplomatic tensions.

quests.instruction: Choose the best way to handle this situation.
quests.scene: Humanity faces an unprecedented existential risk requiring global co-operation but international trust is at an all-time low.
quests.correctAnswer: Build co-operation on lower-stakes issues first to establish working trust
quests.hint: Trust cannot be assumed in a crisis — it must be built incrementally. Use current lower-stakes issues to create working relationships.
quests.explanation: Incremental trust-building before a crisis creates the diplomatic infrastructure that crises require.

quests.instruction: Choose the best way to handle this situation.
quests.scene: Humanity faces an unprecedented existential risk requiring global co-operation but international trust is at an all-time low.
quests.correctAnswer: Create transparent verifiable agreements where trust is insufficient
quests.hint: When trust is low design agreements that do not require it: verification transparency mutual inspection and graduated commitment.
quests.explanation: Verification-based agreements work precisely because they do not depend on trust that may not exist.

quests.instruction: Choose the best way to handle this situation.
quests.scene: Humanity faces an unprecedented existential risk requiring global co-operation but international trust is at an all-time low.
quests.correctAnswer: Engage civil society science and business — not only governments — in the global response
quests.hint: Global challenges are not only solved by governments. Engage the full diversity of actors who have both stake and capacity.
quests.explanation: Multi-actor engagement in existential risk responses creates resilience and legitimacy that state-only solutions cannot provide.
